requirements.text: Registered mechanisms plus validated declarative composition: Extension is possible without executing arbitrary imported/generated code
requirements.positive_oracle: Register reviewed typed mechanisms and bounded declarative operators with unit/coverage/source fixtures.
requirements.negative_oracle: Import code, unknown operators, invalid units or unauthorized state writes; reject before execution without assigning invented effects.
requirements.assertion: Registered mechanisms plus validated declarative composition: Extension is possible without executing arbitrary imported/generated code

requirements.text: Deterministic numeric/transition contracts: Results can be traced and replayed within explicit model/runtime boundaries
requirements.positive_oracle: Replay stable instance/event/purpose/draw keys with explicit paired/new-realization forks and one realization per shared variable.
requirements.negative_oracle: Insert an unrelated instance/draw or reorder events; prior draws cannot shift, collide or become independently resampled shared causes.
requirements.assertion: Deterministic numeric/transition contracts: Results can be traced and replayed within explicit model/runtime boundaries

requirements.text: Separate design and timeline histories: Counterfactual design and historical transformation remain distinguishable
requirements.positive_oracle: Compare continuous run with checkpoint/resume/replay for identical canonical state/evidence/draw identities.
requirements.negative_oracle: Cache eviction, canceled chunks and retries cannot remove confirmed evidence or persist duplicate/partial transitions.
requirements.assertion: Separate design and timeline histories: Counterfactual design and historical transformation remain distinguishable

requirements.text: No built-in optimum or default goals: Measurements supply evidence for player judgment
requirements.positive_oracle: Observe known/partial/missing/unmodeled/conflict/solver-failure/not-applicable results with units, scopes and independent target comparisons.
requirements.negative_oracle: Change only goals; allocations and physical outcomes must remain identical, with no ranking, false zero or whole-system sufficiency from partial coverage.
requirements.assertion: No built-in optimum or default goals: Measurements supply evidence for player judgment

requirements.text: First-class OpenRouter BYOK adapter: Provider features, routing, costs, capabilities, and privacy remain explicit
requirements.positive_oracle: Discover timestamped live/mock model catalog with unknown metadata and declared generic-adapter subsets; preserve actual route/model identity.

requirements.assertion: First-class OpenRouter BYOK adapter: Provider features, routing, costs, capabilities, and privacy remain explicit

requirements.text: AI preview/proposal authority only: Generated assistance cannot silently mutate a civilization
requirements.positive_oracle: Capture every outgoing opening/tool/error/history/continuation payload under a bounded immutable per-turn sharing capability and cumulative manifest.
requirements.negative_oracle: Injection requesting excluded private/branch facts or existence metadata produces no unauthorized bytes; revocation blocks every later dispatch.
requirements.assertion: AI preview/proposal authority only: Generated assistance cannot silently mutate a civilization

requirements.text: Versioned evidence, model coverage, and source lineage: A source claim, a hypothesis, and a computed consequence remain distinguishable

requirements.negative_oracle: Tampered digest, citation-as-primary-ID, missing lineage or silently superseded arithmetic must fail validation or explicit model activation.
requirements.assertion: Versioned evidence, model coverage, and source lineage: A source claim, a hypothesis, and a computed consequence remain distinguishable
